findings.title: Track UMD namespace exports as shared ambient inputs
findings.body: An external declaration file can expose globals with `export as namespace Foo` without containing a `declare global` or string-named module declaration. Its AST contains a `NamespaceExportDeclaration`, so this predicate rejects it. With `allowUmdGlobalAccess`, a component may legally derive its props from `Foo.Props` without importing that declaration file; the file is then absent from `sharedAmbient` and the component's dependencies, leaving live and offline cached metadata stale after edits. Recognize namespace-export declarations (or otherwise detect the source file's UMD global exports) as shared ambient inputs.

overall_explanation: The new ambient-input discovery covers global scripts, `declare global`, and module augmentations, but misses the standard `export as namespace` form used by UMD declaration files. Consequently, supported components using those ambient namespaces can still retain stale dependency metadata.
